baseline.best_norm: Fishers should be mindful of the shared lake and avoid taking so much that the fish cannot recover. Take a reasonable, fair share.

textgrad.best_norm: Each fisher may catch at most 7 fish per month. Exceeding the cap forfeits the excess to restock the lake. Shares are equal across all five fishers so the lake regenerates each month.
